problems.stem: The function $p$ is defined by $p(x)=a\bigl((x+5)^2-b\bigr)\bigl((x+5)^2-c\bigr)$, where $a$, $b$, and $c$ are constants. In the $xy$-plane, the graph of $y=p(x)$ passes through the points $(-4,34)$ and $(0,150)$. What is the value of $p(-10)+p(-4)$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The median and the mean of the five integers $\{20,\,11,\,23,\,x,\,x\}$ are equal.\par\smallskip What is the sum of all possible values of $x$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the $xy$-plane, the graph of function $f$, where $y=f(x)$, has exactly 8 $x$-intercepts. One of these $x$-intercepts is $(17,0)$. The rational function $g$ is defined by $g(x)=\dfrac{f(x)}{x-17}$. In the $xy$-plane, how many $x$-intercepts does the graph of $y=g(x)$ have?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the formula $P=\dfrac{5}{12}K+30$, if $P$ is increased by 30, what is the increase in $K$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$8x^2+64px+8y^2-64py=-224p^2$$ In the $xy$-plane, the graph of the given equation is a circle. The length of the radius of the circle is $np$, where $n$ and $p$ are positive constants. What is the value of $n$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=(x-7)(x-4)(x+k)$, where $k$ is a constant. In the $xy$-plane, the graph of $y=f(x)$ passes through the point $(-2,0)$. What is the value of $f(0)$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$10x+7y=27$$ $$5x+14y=45$$ The solution to the given system of equations is $(x,y)=\left(\dfrac{p}{60},\dfrac{z}{124}\right)$, where $p$ and $z$ are integers. What is the value of $z-p$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $x^2+7x+6$ has two solutions $r$ and $s$, $r<s$, and $x^2+6x-7$ has two solutions $t$ and $u$, $t<u$. If $x^2+cx+d$ has two solutions $t+r$ and $u+s$, what is the value of $c$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$x(kx-20)=-1$$ In the given equation, $k$ is an integer constant. If the equation has two distinct real solutions, what is the greatest possible value of $k$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$f(x)=9^x+4$$ $$g(x)=7x+b$$ The given system of equations intersects at points $(e,f)$ and $(g,h)$, where $h<f$. What is the least possible value of $b$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: Circle $A$: $x^2+(y-1)^2=25$\par Circle $B$: $x^2+(y-1)^2=81$\par\smallskip Determine the difference in area between the two circles in units of $\pi$.
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The surface area of rectangular prism $A$ is $126$ m$^2$. The surface area of rectangular prism $B$ is $4536$ m$^2$. Rectangular prism $A$ has a volume of $85$ m$^3$. If both rectangular prisms are similar, what is the volume of rectangular prism $B$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the $xy$-plane, a parabola has vertex $(-2,-1)$ and intersects the $x$-axis at two points. If the equation of the parabola is written in the form $y=ax^2+bx+c$, where $a$, $b$, and $c$ are constants, which of the following could be the value of $2a+b+3c$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=a^x+b$, where $a$ and $b$ are constants. In the $xy$-plane, the graph of $y=f(x)$ has an $x$-intercept at $(2,0)$ and a $y$-intercept at $(0,-195)$. What is the value of $a+b$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=ax^2+bx+c$, where $a$, $b$, and $c$ are constants and $1<a<4$. The graph of $y=f(x)$ in the $xy$-plane passes through the points $(-10,0)$ and $(-5,0)$. If $a$ is an integer, what could be the value of $a+b$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In a set of four consecutive odd integers, where the integers are ordered from least to greatest, the first integer is represented by $x$. The product of 12 and the second odd integer in the set is at most the value of 30 more than the sum of the third and fourth odd integers in the set. What is the greatest possible value of $x$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$f(x)=5x^2+20x+148$$ The function $g$ is defined by $g(x)=f(x+4)$. What is the minimum value of $g(x)$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A line intersects two parallel lines, forming four acute angles and four obtuse angles. The measure of one of the acute angles is $(4x-410)^\circ$. The sum of the measures of one of the acute angles and three of the obtuse angles is $(-8x+w)^\circ$. What is the value of $w$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the figure shown, if the radius of circle $O$ is 12, what is the length of diagonal $AC$ of rectangle $OABC$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $(x+4)$ is a factor of the quadratic function $y=f(x)$, and $x=c$ is a positive zero of the function. If the minimum of the function is $\left(\dfrac{3}{4},k\right)$, what is the value of $c$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$f(x)=-(x-a)(x-b)$$ The function $f$ is defined by the given equation, where $a$ and $b$ are integer constants. If $f(-30)<0$, $f(-10)>0$ and $f(20)<0$ and $a<b$, what is the minimum possible value of $a-b$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The table shows the volume of two similar solids, right circular cylinder $A$ and right circular cylinder $B$. The radius of right circular cylinder $A$ is 8 units. The surface area of right circular cylinder $A$ is $k\pi$ square units, and the surface area of right circular cylinder $B$ is $n\pi$ square units, where $k$ and $n$ are constants. What is the value of $\dfrac{n}{k}$? (The surface area of a right circular cylinder with radius $r$ and height $h$ is $2\pi r^2+2\pi rh$.)
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The function $k$ is defined by $k(s)=\sqrt{s+84}$. If $k(5p)=p$, where $p$ is a constant, what is the value of $p$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: 55 gallons of a $p\%$ chlorine solution are added to 12 gallons of a $15\%$ chlorine solution to make a $70\%$ chlorine solution. What is the value of $p$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The expression $6x^2+bx-35$, where $b$ is a constant, can be rewritten as $(hx+k)(x+j)$, where $h$, $k$, and $j$ are integer constants. Which of the following must be an integer?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A farmer has a square field that measures 50 meters on each side. If one sack of seed covers 250 square meters, how many sacks of seed does the farmer need to plant the entire field?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The radius of circle $Y$ is 9 times longer than the radius of circle $X$. If circle $X$ has an area with length $y$, what is the length of circle $Y$'s area?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: Cylinder $A$ has a volume of $V$. Cylinder $B$ has a radius that is equal to cylinder $A$'s diameter as well as a height that is three times shorter than the height of cylinder $A$. Which of the following expressions correctly represent the volume of cylinder $B$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The graph of the equation $3x-2y=6$ is translated 4 units down and 2 units to the left.\par\smallskip What is the $y$-coordinate of the $y$-intercept of the resulting graph?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the $xy$-plane, a line with the equation $y=mx-30$ does not intersect with a parabola with the equation $y=2x^2-3x-m$, where $m$ is a constant. Which of the following is a possible value for $m$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A bakery sold cookies in the ratio of chocolate chip to oatmeal as $4:3$. If the bakery sold 280 chocolate chip cookies, how many oatmeal cookies were sold?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The table shows the exponential relationship between the time, in months, since a new colony of bacteria was introduced to a petri dish and the total number of bacteria. If the number of bacteria increases by a fixed percentage each month, what is the value of $b$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A music school offers a series of three workshops. 800 people signed up for the first workshop. $45\%$ of the people who signed up for the first workshop also signed up for the second workshop, and $20\%$ of the people who signed up for both the first and second workshops also signed up for the third workshop. How many people signed up for all three workshops?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: Data set $A$ contains 8 values, and data set $B$ contains 24 values. The table shows the frequencies of the values for each data set. Which of the following statements best compares the means of the two data sets?
choices: The mean of data set A is greater than the mean of data set B.
The mean of data set A is less than the mean of data set B.
The mean of data set A is equal to the mean of data set B.
There is not enough information to compare the means of the data sets.
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$(x+4)^2+(x^2+4x)=(x+4)(x-8)$$ In the given equation, $x\neq-4$. What is the solution to the given equation?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In triangles $XYZ$ and $PQR$, it is known that $2XY=PQ$. If the triangles are similar, which of the following must be true?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the given equation, $m$ is a positive constant. The product of the solutions to the equation is 28. What is the value of $m$? $$\tfrac{2}{3}(3x+7)\bigl(x+\sqrt{2m+6}\bigr)\bigl(x-\sqrt{2m+6}\bigr)=0$$
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: An orchard has 5 rows of apple trees, 6 rows of pear trees, and 2 rows of cherry trees. Each row of apple trees has 7 trees 25 feet or taller and 4 trees shorter than 25 feet. Each row of pear trees has 9 trees 25 feet or taller and 6 trees shorter than 25 feet. Each row of cherry trees has 12 trees 25 feet or taller and 3 trees shorter than 25 feet. A tree from one of these rows will be selected at random. What is the probability of selecting a pear tree, given that the tree is 25 feet or taller?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the $xy$-plane, a circle has center $C$ with coordinates $(p,8)$, where $p$ is a constant. Points $G$ and $H$ lie on the circle. Point $G$ has coordinates $(p+3\sqrt{5},14)$, and point $H$ has coordinates $(q,8)$, where $q$ is a constant greater than $p$. What is the area, in square units, of triangle $CGH$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A square has an area of $x+15$ square units and a perimeter of $2x$ units. What is the value of $x$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the figure, line $p$ is parallel to line $q$, and line $r$ intersects both lines. What is the value of $y$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: Function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=4x^2-12x+5$ on the $xy$-plane, where $f(x)=y$. Function $g$ intersects the $x$-axis twice when graphed on the $xy$-plane. Which of the following equations could define $g(x)$, if $k$ represents a positive constant?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: Circle $A$ is defined by the equation $(x-3)^2+(y+2)^2=16$. Circle $B$ (not shown) is the result of shifting circle $A$ up 5 units and decreasing the radius so that the radius of circle $B$ is half the radius of circle $A$. Which equation defines circle $B$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In convex pentagon $ABCDE$, segment $AB$ is parallel to segment $DE$. The measure of angle $B$ is 125 degrees, and the measure of angle $D$ is 160 degrees. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle $C$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the figure, $\overline{AE}$ intersects $\overline{BD}$ at point $C$, and $\overline{AB}$ is parallel to $\overline{DE}$. The lengths of $\overline{BC}$, $\overline{AC}$, and $\overline{CD}$ are $\dfrac{21}{4}$, $7$, and $6$, respectively. What is the length of $\overline{AE}$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the $xy$-plane, a circle has center $C$ with coordinates $(h,k)$. Points $A$ and $B$ lie on the circle. Point $A$ has coordinates $(h+3,k+4)$, and $\angle ACB$ is a right angle. What is the length of $\overline{AB}$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A rectangle is inscribed in a circle such that each vertex of the rectangle lies on the circumference of the circle. The diagonal of the rectangle is twice the length of the shortest side of the rectangle. The area of the rectangle is $784\sqrt{3}$ square units. What is the length, in units, of the diameter of the circle?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$(x+5)^2+(y-3)^2=100$$ The graph of the given equation represents a circle in the $xy$-plane. The point $(a,a-2)$ lies on the circle. Which of the following is a possible value for $a$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A right square prism has a height of 18 units. The volume of the prism is 2,592 cubic units. What is the length, in units, of an edge of the base?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: For a magnetic field passing through a flat surface perpendicular to it, the magnetic flux through the surface is the product of the magnetic field's strength and the area of the surface. A certain flat surface consists of two adjacent squares. The side length of the larger square is twice the side length of the smaller square. A magnetic field with strength 20.00 teslas passes uniformly through this surface, perpendicular to the magnetic field. If the total magnetic flux through this surface is 2,000 teslas $\cdot$ meters$^2$, what is the magnetic flux, in teslas $\cdot$ meters$^2$, through the larger square?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)=x^2+bx+c$, where $b$ and $c$ are constants. If the $x$-intercepts of the graph of $f$ in the $xy$-plane are $-2$ and $5$, what is the value of $b$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The equation $x^2+mx+5=0$, where $m$ is a positive integer, has no real solutions. What is the greatest possible value of $m$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: Given the function $g(x)=33(k)^x$, where $k$ is a positive constant. For each increase of 1 in the value of $x$, the value of $g(x)$ increases by $p\%$, where $0<p<200$. Which expression represents $p$ in terms of $k$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A right circular cone has a radius of $a$ and a height of $b$. A larger cone has a volume that is 243 times the volume of the smaller cone. Which of the following could represent the radius $A$, in terms of $a$, and the height $B$, in terms of $b$, of the larger cone?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: For a quadratic function $f(x)=x^2+bx+c$, the value $f(2)=-1$ is the vertex of the function. What is the value of $c$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: In the figure above, the ratio of the lengths $AQ:QR:RC=1:3:2$. If the area of quadrilateral $PQRS$ is 60, what is the area of $\triangle ABC$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The function $p$ is defined by $p(x)=c\left(2.5^x+2.5^d\right)$, where $c$ and $d$ are positive integer constants and $c<d$. The functions $q$ and $r$ are equivalent to function $p$, where $s$ and $t$ are constants. Which of the following equations displays the $y$-coordinate of the $y$-intercept of the graph of $y=p(x)$ in the $xy$-plane as a constant or coefficient?\par\smallskip I. $q(x)=c\left(2.5^x+s\right)$\par II. $r(x)=c\left(2.5\right)^x+t$
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A certain bamboo plant grows 35 centimeters every $p$ months. At this rate, which expression represents the number of centimeters, on average, the bamboo plant grows every $k$ years?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: Data set $A$ consists of $n$ consecutive integers, where $n$ is an odd integer greater than 3. The smallest integer in set $A$ is $m$. Data set $B$ is created by adding the integer $(m-5)$ to set $A$. Which of the following statements must be true?\par\smallskip I. The range of set $B$ is greater than the range of set $A$.\par II. The median of set $B$ is less than the median of set $A$.\par III. The mean of set $B$ is less than the mean of set $A$.
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The function $V$ models the value, in dollars, of a rare coin $t$ years after 1990: $$V(t)=500(1.06)^{\frac{t}{3}}$$ According to the model, the value of the coin is predicted to increase by $6\%$ every $n$ years. What is the value of $n$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The graph of line $g$ is shown in the $xy$-plane. Line $s$ is defined by $150x+ny=-m$, where $n$ and $m$ are constants. If line $s$ is graphed in this $xy$-plane, resulting in the graph of a system of two linear equations, the system of two linear equations will have infinitely many solutions. What is the value of $n+m$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The function $h$ is defined by $h(x)=(x+1)(x-4)(x-7)^2$. The value of $h(5+m)$ is 0, where $m$ is a constant. What is the sum of all possible values of $m$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A right rectangular prism has a height of 5 meters. The length of the prism's base is $w$ meters, which is 4 meters more than the width of the prism's base. Which function $V$ gives the volume of the prism, in cubic meters, in terms of the length of the prism's base?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The surface area of a cube is $6(3c)^2$, where $c$ is a positive constant. Which of the following gives the perimeter of one face of the cube?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$3x^2+6ax+12=0$$ The equation has no real solutions if $a^2<j$. What is the greatest possible integer value of $j$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $$14x^2+(14m+3n)x+3mn=0$$ In the function, $m$ and $n$ are positive constants. The product of the solutions to the given equation is $pmn$, where $p$ is a constant. What is the value of $p$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: A bakery makes loaves of bread in three sizes: small, medium, and large. On a particular morning, the bakery makes twice as many small loaves as medium loaves, represented by $m$. They also bake 20 large loaves. If the bakery makes a total of 80 loaves that morning, which equation represents this situation?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: The function $f(x)$ is defined by $f(x)=m\bigl((x-3)^2-n\bigr)\bigl((x-3)^2-p\bigr)$, where $m$, $n$, and $p$ are constants. In the $xy$-plane, the graph of $y=f(x)$ passes through the points $(2,12)$ and $(6,108)$. What is the value of $f(1)+f(5)$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: Data set $X$ consists of the weights of 60 animals and has a mean of 30 kg. Data set $Y$ consists of the weights of 40 animals and has a mean of 50 kg. Data set $Z$ consists of the weights of the 100 animals from data sets $X$ and $Y$.\par\smallskip What is the mean, in kilograms, of data set $Z$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: Points $P\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)$ and $Q(0,1)$ are located on the unit circle with center $O(0,0)$. Which of the following could be the measure of angle $\angle POQ$?
problems.src_name: Collection of 70 HARD SAT Math questions (Merey Altaiuly)

problems.stem: $(x+7)$ is a factor of the quadratic function $y=f(x)$, and $x=c$ is a positive zero of the function. If the minimum of the function is $\left(\dfrac{63}{8},k\right)$, what is the value of $c$?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: For two acute angles, $\angle A$ and $\angle B$, $\cos A=\sin B$. The measures, in degrees, of $\angle A$ and $\angle B$ are $13x+10$ and $48+3x$, respectively. What is the value of $x$?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: A baseball coach charges each athlete \$150 for the first month and \$95 for each additional month. Which of the following functions correctly represents the total revenue $R(m)$, in dollars, for $m$ months and $n$ athletes, where $m$ and $n$ are positive integers?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: $$y=-3x^2-58$$ $$y=px-46$$ In the given system of equations, $p$ is a constant. The graphs of the equations in the given system intersect at exactly one point, $(x,y)$ in the $xy$-plane. Which of the following could be the value of $x$?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: $$f(x)=-7x+b$$ For the given function $f(x)$, which of the following gives the equation for the function $f(x)+20$, given that the point $(-4,0)$ lies on the graph of $f(x)-20$?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: The positive number $a$ is $480\%$ of the number $b$, and $a$ is $70\%$ of the number $c$. If $c$ is $p\%$ of $b$, which of the following is closest to the value of $p$?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: $$f(x)=a^x-b$$ The exponential function given above passes through points $(c,8)$ and $(2c,350)$. What is a possible value of $b$?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: The table gives the volume of two similar cylinders. If the radius of cylinder $A$ is 9 cm. What is the value of $j-k$?\par\smallskip Volume $=\pi r^2h$\par Surface area $=2\pi r^2+2\pi rh$
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: For the function $f$, for every increase of $\dfrac{1}{2}$ in the value of $x$, the value of $f(x)$ increases by a factor of $c$, where $c$ is a constant. Which of the following forms of function $f$ displays the value of $c$ as the base or coefficient?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: The quadratic function $ax^2+200x+c$ has at least one real solution. What is the greatest possible value of $ac$?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: A polygon has exactly 97 sides. If the measure of each of the 97 interior angles of this polygon is $(180p)^\circ$, what is the value of $p$?
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)

problems.stem: A certain town has an area of 5.48 square miles. Which of the following is closest to the area, in square yards, of this town? (1 mile $=$ 1,760 yards)
problems.src_name: Advanced Digital SAT Math - 150 Hard Questions (Matthew Stroup & Michael Stroup)
